subject: [hw] DONE V11
body:
V11 (A32 media / saturating arithmetic / divide) is implemented and host-tested.

Last line of the test command:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/run_tests.sh
    gen_enc.py: 172 encodings
    N2TEST V11 PASS 953/953
    N2TEST V11 PASS 953/953
(Both builds: -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all and -O2, -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror, clang 23.1.4, x86-64. 953 checks each: 901 data cases, 52 deliberate-UNDEF cases, one 200000-word random sweep of the class encoding space.)

Files:
  gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_arm_media.c          (new, MIT, 793 lines)
  gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/t_v11.c           (new, test driver)
  gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/v11_enc.s         (new, 172 llvm-mc encodings)
  gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/gen_enc.py        (new, .s -> #define ENC_* generator)
  gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/run_tests.sh      (new, builds only under /tmp/n2hw-V11)
  gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/STATUS.md         (new, full report: mnemonics, UNDEF list, risks)
  gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/k_v11_media.c     (new, differential kernels for T01)
  gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V11/STATUS.md (handoff summary requested by the lead)
No build product, dump or vendor file is in the tree: du -sh emu/test_v11 = 132K, emu/n2a32_arm_media.c = 28K, no file above 300 KB.

Implemented (all variants): SXTB SXTH UXTB UXTH SXTAB SXTAH UXTAB UXTAH SXTB16 SXTAB16 UXTB16 UXTAB16 (ROR 0/8/16/24); UBFX SBFX BFI BFC; REV REV16 REVSH RBIT; SSAT USAT SSAT16 USAT16; PKHBT PKHTB SEL; SADD16 SASX SSAX SSUB16 SADD8 SSUB8; QADD16 QASX QSAX QSUB16 QADD8 QSUB8; SHADD16 SHASX SHSAX SHSUB16 SHADD8 SHSUB8; UADD16 UASX USAX USUB16 UADD8 USUB8; UQADD16 UQASX UQSAX UQSUB16 UQADD8 UQSUB8; UHADD16 UHASX UHSAX UHSUB16 UHADD8 UHSUB8; QADD QSUB QDADD QDSUB; SMULBB/BT/TB/TT; SMLABB/BT/TB/TT; SMULWB/WT; SMLAW B/WT; SMLALBB/BT/TB/TT; SMUAD(X) SMUSD(X) SMLAD(X) SMLSD(X) SMLALD(X) SMLSLD(X); SMMUL(R) SMMLA(R) SMMLS(R); USAD8 USADA8; SDIV UDIV.
Flag rules: S/U parallel variants set GE (signed: exact lane sum >= 0; unsigned: carry / no borrow); Q/SH/UQ/UH variants change no flag at all; SSAT/USAT/SSAT16/USAT16 and Q*ADD/Q*SUB set Q on saturation; SMUAD(X)/SMLAD(X)/SMLSD(X)/SMLAxy/SMLAWy set Q on exact 32-bit overflow; nothing touches NZCV. Deliberate UNDEF list: emu/test_v11/STATUS.md section 3 (unallocated sub-spaces, fixed-bit violations, r15 operands, RdLo==RdHi).

Not done / open:
1. The T01 differential kernels are written (emu/test_v11/k_v11_media.c, 10 kernels; the ARM object emits ubfx uxth uxtb ssat pkhbt uxtah sxtb smmul rev rbit qadd qsub bfi from plain C) but are NOT in tests/emu/kernels: I do not own tests/emu/**. Posted to hw-t01 to copy; if you prefer, tell me and I will take ownership of the install. Also suggested to hw-t01: add +hwdiv to the ARM configurations so SDIV/UDIV are exercised (currently / lowers to __aeabi_idiv).
2. SMUSD/SMUSDX and Q: I leave Q unchanged (Arm A32/T32 instruction-set reference gives the Q rule for SMUAD only; the ARM1136 Q-flag list names SMUAD/SMLAD/SMLSD/SMLAxy/SMLAWy but not SMUSD). Marked [I] in STATUS.md as an open question; only code reading Q after SMUSD would differ.
3. USAT #0 semantics taken as "saturate to 0..0" from the "0 <= x <= 2^sat - 1" wording ([I]).
4. emu/n2a32_core.c currently routes LDR/STR-register words ([27:25]=011, bit24=0) to this class; they return N2A32_UNDEF (V12 and T01 have posted the exact core fix).
5. No phone test (there is no device-dependent code in this package) and nothing published.

I am staying available for review findings (R1/R2) and will post DONE V11 rev N after fixing them.
